title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
preamble: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on 1 September 2026 between Ai-Q Labs and Northwind Labs, each of which may disclose confidential information to the other in connection with the upcoming logistics integration project.

clauses.heading: Purpose
clauses.text: The parties wish to exchange confidential information for the sole purpose of evaluating and carrying out the upcoming logistics integration project.

clauses.heading: Mutual Obligations
clauses.text: Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information in confidence and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent. Both parties carry the same obligations under this agreement.

clauses.heading: Term
clauses.text: This agreement takes effect on 1 September 2026 and shall remain in effect for two years from that date.

clauses.heading: Survival
clauses.text: The confidentiality obligations in this agreement continue for three years after termination.

clauses.heading: Automatic Renewal
clauses.text: Unless either party gives notice to the contrary, this agreement will automatically renew for successive one-year periods.

clauses.heading: Non-Solicitation
clauses.text: For twelve months following termination, neither party shall solicit or employ any person employed by the other party.

clauses.heading: Termination
clauses.text: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving 30 days written notice to the other party.

clauses.heading: Governing Law
clauses.text: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, and the parties submit to the jurisdiction of its courts.

signature_block: Signed by the duly authorised representatives of each party as of the date first written above.
